entries.value: Their own safety — they feared the consequences of loyalty more than disloyalty
Wealth — they were simply paid enough to turn
Protection of a loved one — someone they care about was threatened
Advancement — loyalty to the players was a dead end
Revenge — some old wrong, real or imagined, that the players did not know about
Ideological — they genuinely believe the players' enemies are right
Desperation — they had no good options left and this seemed least bad
Cowardice — they simply could not hold firm under pressure
